subject: art-design
title: Types of Line
welcome_lead: Straight, curved, zigzag — line gives drawings their voice.
meta_desc: KS3 line: types of line, line weight, expressive line.
final_note: Vary your line and the drawing comes alive.

concepts.def: Path made by a moving point.
Line marking the edge of a shape.

walkthroughs.body_html: Lines can be straight, curved, wavy, zigzag, dotted, broken and more. Each carries a different feeling — curves feel calm, zigzags feel jagged and exciting.
Line weight is how thick a line is. Heavier line near the foreground and thinner line at the back suggests depth. Vary line weight on every drawing.
An angry drawing uses sharp jagged lines. A gentle one uses flowing curves. Choose your line to fit the feeling.
